facts.fact: The page cites a study of connected TV advertising reporting that CTV ads achieve 90%+ completion rates.
facts.quote: A [study of connected TV advertising](https://adwave.com/resources/what-is-connected-tv-advertising/) shows that CTV ads achieve 90%+ completion rates

facts.fact: The page states that the average Facebook video ad gets watched for less than 6 seconds, in the same connected TV study it cites.
facts.quote: while the average Facebook video ad gets watched for less than 6 seconds.

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Meta ads CPM (cost per 1,000 impressions) at $10-15.
The page lists the average CPM for small business advertisers on Meta ads at $12.
The page lists the minimum Meta ads budget at about $5 per day.
The page lists the effective CPM (cost per completed view) for Meta ads at $48-80.
The page lists the video completion rate for Meta ads at 15-25%.
The page states that Adwave's CTV platform starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: CTV platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/pricing/) start at $30 a day

facts.fact: The page states that a professional TV commercial could historically cost between $5,000 and $50,000+.
facts.quote: A professional TV commercial could cost $5,000-$50,000+.

facts.fact: The page states that CTV ads are typically 15 to 30 seconds long.
facts.quote: CTV ads are non-skippable and typically 15-30 seconds.

facts.fact: The page states that Apple's iOS 14.5 App Tracking Transparency changes reduced Meta's ability to track users across apps.
facts.quote: iOS 14.5's App Tracking Transparency gutted Meta's ability to track users across apps.

facts.fact: The page's decision framework suggests Meta ads when budget is extremely limited, defined as under $500 per month.
Adwave suggests considering both CTV and Meta ads when total ad budget is $1,000+ per month.
facts.quote: Consider both when: You have $1,000+/month total ad budget

facts.fact: Adwave's suggested allocation for SMBs with $500-1,000 per month total budget is 70% Meta and 30% CTV.
Adwave's suggested allocation for SMBs with $1,000-2,500 per month total budget is 50% Meta and 50% CTV.
Adwave's suggested allocation for SMBs with $2,500+ per month total budget is 40% Meta and 60% CTV.
